title: Pay early with many properties unowned
description: Pay early with many properties unowned. Alpha should keep moving while acquisition is still open. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll pay the $50 fine and get back on the board.
final_action.private_thought: I have ample cash and own a full orange set. Paying $50 ensures I leave jail now and can start building houses without losing a turn. Rolling for doubles risks a turn loss for minimal savings.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
